title: Xiaomi Redmi Smart TV A Pro 55" 2025 Energy-saving (MiTV-ASTR0, blueplanet, Amlogic
notes:
Xiaomi Redmi Smart TV A Pro 55" 2025 Energy-saving (MiTV-ASTR0, blueplanet, Amlogic
AMLT963D4/T5M), China firmware OS3.0.106.0.USTAATV (HyperOS TV 3), Android 14 (SDK 34),
3 GB RAM. Stock launcher com.mitv.tvhome (PatchWall) - its line at the bottom is
commented out by default: on this build the stock launcher was replaced through the
com.ts.launcher allowlist trampoline (see the PatchWall block and the device doc)
before disabling it; uncomment that line only together with that setup.
Disabled and lived with on 2026-10-22; the screensaver-ad package was verified live
(resumed activity while the ad showed). See docs/devices/xiaomi-mitv-astr0-blueplanet.md
for the ad screensaver, the Home allowlist behavior and what must stay enabled.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-astr0/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-astr0/debloat.txt com.mitv.tvhome
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Notes from this firmware:
- The standby/screensaver ads come from com.xiaomi.mitv.hyper.screensaver: a plain
Activity with its own downloaded carousel, not a DreamService, so screensaver_enabled=0
does not touch it. com.mitv.screensaver / com.xiaomi.mitv.advertise do not exist here.
- Keep com.xiaomi.mitv.smartpanel enabled (Menu-button panel: source switcher +
wireless tiles). Do NOT add it here; disabling it kills the Menu key.
- ADB over TCP closes on every boot: Settings -> 账号与安全 -> ADB 调试.
- No idle clock screensaver is possible: the idle timeout path is a hard panel-off
(suspend), the AOSP dream never renders. Keep screen_off_timeout at 2147483647.
